input.title: Multiselect snapshot is different in full run vs incremental run
input.body: ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Run `yarn test:puppeteer` from the command line 2. Open `src/e2e/puppeteer/__tests__/multiselect.ts` once it finishes (and hopefully everything passes) 3. Save `multiselect.ts` (without making any changes) to kick off an incremental run in watch mode ## Current Behavior The `mobile only - should multiselect two thoughts at once` test fails on the incremental run, because its snapshot is different from when it was generated during the full run. ## Expected Behavior All tests should generate the same snapshot during a full run as during an incremental run.
